Alle Klassen und Schnittstellen

Klasse
Beschreibung
AntiXRayFeature
The features of NexusAntiXRay that can be switched individually, globally under features in config.yml and per world under worlds.overrides.<world>.features.
BaitVeinHitEvent
Called each time the x-ray detection counts a bait vein for a player.
BypassChangeEvent
Called after the effective bypass of a player has changed, that is whenever NexusAntiXRayApi.isBypassed(org.bukkit.entity.Player) starts to return a different value for the player.
BypassChangeEvent.Cause
What changed the bypass of a player.
MiningStats
What the x-ray detection has counted for one player, as an immutable snapshot taken by NexusAntiXRayApi.getStats(java.util.UUID).
NexusAntiXRayApi
Entry point of the NexusAntiXRay API.
StoredMiningStats
What NexusAntiXRay has stored for one player across server restarts, as an immutable snapshot loaded by NexusAntiXRayApi.loadStats(java.util.UUID).
ThrottleLevelChangeEvent
Called when the self-throttling of NexusAntiXRay (performance.auto-throttle in its config) changes its level.
ThrottleLevelChangeEvent.Cause
Why the level changed.
ThrottleLevelChangeEvent.TickSource
Where the tick time of ThrottleLevelChangeEvent.getTickMillis() comes from.
XRayAlertEvent
Called when the x-ray detection is about to raise an alert for a player, before anything is sent.
